gpt-6-luna.spoken: What does “doing it right” feel like right now?
gpt-6-luna.note: Same as D: short and felt, aimed at the ideal.

gpt-5.6-terra+honest4.spoken: What is “doing it right” like in your mind right now?
gpt-5.6-terra+honest4.note: Somewhat abstract, pointing at the mind rather than at experience.

top.why: J turns attention onto the doubt itself, in very few words, without trying to resolve it.

bottom.why: N is garbled spoken aloud and introduces the idea of doing it wrong.
